_about: Read by `kit lint` (CI's lint job runs it). `full`: trees held to the whole ruff rule set in pyproject.toml and fully formatted. `ratchet`: trees not there yet (R-15, #26). Each must have zero real errors (ruff F, minus the `floor_ignore` codes), and may not exceed its count of full-rule-set violations (`lint`) or of unformatted files (`format`). A count below its floor also fails, until `kit lint --update-baseline` lowers it in the same PR. Never raise a floor by hand. Every tracked .py file must sit under a full, ratchet or exempt tree (doctor: lint_policy_covers), so new code cannot land unlinted.

exempt.packages/discovery-engine/prototypes: vendored verbatim from Fork C and Fork E; doctor's vendored_verbatim keeps it byte-identical
exempt.docs/iq/staged-config: staged configuration kept for reference, never imported or run
